name: @oge-ui/spreadsheet-engine
description: Framework-free engine of the OGE UI Spreadsheet, shared by its Angular and React render layers: a dependency-free xlsx reader (styles, merges, links, notes, pictures, charts, conditional formats, opaque passthrough, import issues), Excel number formats, the paint model (Excel-measured column widths, row heights, border precedence and text fitting) and the viewer core (selection, Excel keyboard map, find, copy). Runs without a DOM (Node, Web Workers). Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
